periods.time: After Eina's approval, on the way through the 12th floor

name.zh: 贝尔、莉莉与韦尔夫进入中层
name.en: Bell, Lili, and Welf Enter the Middle Floors

periods.summary: Bell, Lili, and Welf fight through the 12th floor toward the middle-floor entrance. Bell uses the new crimson short blade Ushiwakamaru alongside the Hestia Knife, coordinates with Lili's quick sword handoff, saves Welf from an Orc strike, and the trio settles on a middle-floor formation before stepping into the 13th floor.
periods.cause: Eina conditionally approved middle-floor entry, and the party's three-person structure gives Bell enough confidence to proceed.
periods.process: The party breaks through the fog layer, clears monsters near the entrance, and uses coordinated tactics: Lili positions Bell's greatsword for a running draw, Bell shatters an Orc's club, and Welf finishes the monster. Lili then assigns Welf as front guard, Bell as center support/offense, and herself as rear guard despite warning that their firepower balance remains unstable.
periods.outcome: The party enters the middle floors together, with Bell feeling excitement at adventuring with reliable companions despite the danger ahead.
periods.aftermath: Welf's attached status profile reveals he is Lv.1, has the antimagic fire spell Will-o-Wisp, and the Magic Sword Blood skill that enables and strengthens magic sword creation.
periods.significance: Concludes the main volume by moving Bell's newly formed party into the next dungeon stage and confirming the team roles that will define their middle-floor challenge.
